facts.statement: The only currently described species is Cratoavis cearensis.
Cratoavis belongs to the group of birds known as enantiornithines.
facts.quote: Cratoavis is a genus of enantiornithines.

facts.statement: The fossil was found in the Early Cretaceous Araripe Basin in Ceará, Brazil.
facts.quote: from the Early Cretaceous of Araripe Basin, Ceará, Brazil.

facts.statement: Fish remains found near the holotype's intestine provide direct evidence that Cratoavis ate fish.
facts.quote: This indicates that these fish were probably contained within the digestive tract of Cratoavis, which would make the holotype preserving a direct evidence of piscivory (fish-eating).

facts.statement: The genus name Cratoavis honors the Crato Formation where the specimen was discovered.
facts.quote: The genus was named after the Crato Formation, in which the specimen was found.

facts.statement: The holotype is an articulated skeleton with feathers on the wings and body, extending the known time range of enantiornithines in South America.
facts.quote: The fossil, an articulated skeleton with feathers attached to the wings and surrounding the body, extends considerably the temporal record of the group at South America.

facts.statement: Cratoavis is classified within the family Enantiornithes.
Cratoavis lived during the Late Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous, between 125.45 and 112.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Data del Cretácico Inferior (Aptiano tardío 125.45 – 112.6 Ma.).

facts.statement: The type species consists of an articulated skeleton preserved with attached feathers, muscle tissue, and skin traces.
facts.quote: La especie tipo, Cratoavis cearensis, consiste de un esqueleto articulado con plumas adheridas, tejido muscular y rastros de piel

facts.statement: It is the first nearly complete Cretaceous bird skeleton discovered in South America.
facts.quote: es el primer ejemplar de ave cretácica, descubierto en Sudamérica, con esqueleto casi completo

facts.statement: The genus name means 'Bird of Crato', honoring the site where it was found.
facts.quote: El nombre del género Cratoavis significa “Ave de Crato”, en honor al yacimiento donde fue hallado

facts.statement: The species name cearensis refers to the state of Ceará where the Crato Formation is located.
facts.quote: y el nombre de la especie C. cearensis es en referencia al estado de Ceará, donde se localiza la formación Crato.

facts.statement: The fossil layers indicate a lake environment with still waters containing clay sediments, plant, fish, and insect fossils.
facts.quote: Los estratos donde se encuentra evidencian un ambiente lacustre de aguas lenticas: sedimentos de arcilla junto a restos fósiles de plantas, peces e insectos.

facts.statement: Chemical analysis suggests the ancient lake waters were alkaline and hypersaline.
facts.quote: La química sugiere que las aguas eran alcalinas e hipersalinas

facts.statement: Cratoavis is characterized by having thinner skeletal structures compared to other enantiornithine birds.
facts.quote: Se caracteriza por poseer estructuras esqueléticas más delgadas que en otras aves enantiornitas

facts.statement: Its tail feathers are exceptionally long, reaching up to 30% longer than the total body length.
facts.quote: Las plumas de la cola son muy largas, hasta un 30% más largas que la longitud total del cuerpo

facts.statement: The fossil record for Cratoavis spans from 119.57 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (119.57 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The genus Cratoavis was named by Carvalho et al. in 2015.
